senses.gloss: (cmp. preced.; v. סִיב I) [to be hairy,] to be old.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 22:6">Targ. Prov. XXII, 6</cite> <he>נסאב</he> ed. Lag. (oth. ed. <he>נְסוּב</he>, <he>יְסוּב</he>, <he>נסאובא</he>; Ms. <he>נסאבא</he>).—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 3:4:8">Y. Dem. III, 23ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>כד תִּסְאֲבוּן וכ׳</he> when you are old (appointed elders, v. <cite ref="G00642"><he>זָקֵן</he></cite>), I shall tell you.
